title: A Fast Convergent Algorithm for Solving Non-convex Partially-Decoupled Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problems
summary: Solving multi-agent optimal control problems in aerospace such as pursuit-evasion and contested space operations can be modeled as non-convex differential games for which, there are limited algorithms. In this work, a relaxation of generalized Nash Equilibrium problems (GNEPs) to exclude inter-agent control coupling in dynamics, which is representative of many multi-agent systems is introduced. The main contribution is an algorithm for solving a broad class of differential games named FALCON: Fast Augmented Lagrangian Convexification for Open-loop Nash equilibria is presented.…
